title: SKILLS high-level panel session “Blue Economy in the South Adriatic Region”
summary: Moments from the SKILLS high-level panel at AdriBioPro2024, held in Kotor on 2 October 2024. I facilitated the discussion on connecting research, education and policy to strengthen skills and sustainable blue economy development across the South Adriatic region.

body:
This gallery captures the SKILLS high-level panel session, “Blue Economy in the South Adriatic Region,” held on 2 October 2024 at the “Nikola Đurković” Cultural Centre in Kotor, Montenegro, as part of AdriBioPro2024.

As facilitator, I guided an exchange between representatives of research institutions, public authorities and the Interreg South Adriatic programme. The discussion explored how Montenegro, Albania and southern Italy can connect scientific expertise, education and policy to address the workforce needs of a sustainable blue economy.

Contributions covered applied marine research, specialised training, digital and green competencies, policy coordination and opportunities for joint investment. The SKILLS project provided a shared framework for discussing qualifications, training opportunities and cooperation between institutions and blue economy sectors. An additional contribution connected these priorities with the wider Adriatic–Ionian cooperation agenda through EUSAIR.

The photographs document the panel discussion, contributions from speakers and the audience attending the session. They record an exchange centred on a practical priority: equipping people with the knowledge and skills to support coastal economies while protecting the marine ecosystems on which they depend.
